Ben Cole: Hey finance — I used my personal AmEx to reload a Clipper (SF transit) card for the team offsite yesterday because the vendor only accepted card at counter. Receipt is a tiny paper slip with a batch code but no per-ride timestamps. Can I still expense this? I attached a photo.
finance-bot: Expense helper triggered. Please attach receipt and include vendor name, transaction date, and amount. If receipt lacks timestamps a secondary proof (bank stmt or approver note) can work. See https://intranet.redwood/expenses for policy.
Maya Patel: Hi Ben — thanks. Can you upload the photo here and confirm the project/cost center? If the receipt doesn't show times we can accept a bank statement line + manager approval as evidence.
Ben Cole: Uploaded receipt: receipt_clip_030426.jpg (uploaded). Charge on my AmEx 03/04/2026 $24.50 AmEx ****1234. Project: ENG-OFFSITE. Cost center: eng-ops.
Maya Patel: Got it. @David Ruiz can you confirm this was an approved team expense (shuttle/transit for offsite)? A short approval reply here is fine.
David Ruiz: Confirmed — this was for the team shuttle to/from our offsite. Approving reimbursement for $24.50. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Thanks David — we have manager approval. Ben, two options: 1) Submit in Expensify and attach the uploaded receipt + a screenshot of the AmEx txn (preferred), or 2) Reply "manual" and we process a one-off reimbursement to your payroll. Which do you prefer?
Ben Cole: I'll submit in Expensify now. Submitted request ID 4821, attached receipt and AmEx screenshot.
finance-bot: Reimbursement queued. Status: awaiting finance processing. Expected payout window: next reimbursement run (04/15/2026). If you chose manual processing, reply "manual" within 48h.
Maya Patel: Closing loop — I've flagged this for priority processing since it's under $100 and has manager approval. Ben — ping me if Expensify shows any issue.
